annotations.title: Get Upcoming Catalysts & Active VETO Stream

description: Unified stream of upcoming Red-Folder macro events (scheduled_at, starts_in_sec, pre_veto_minutes), active VETO/PRE_NEWS locks, and recent macro prints scoped to your unlocked pairs. Supports optional currency or symbol filtering.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency code filter (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CAD, CHF, NZD).

limit.description: Maximum historical releases to include (0..25, default 8).
